title: Alternative Firing Workshop with Randy Brodnax
evidence_sentence: The workshop page describes two days of raku firing including naked raku and other techniques.
evidence_quote: Randy will share his throwing & raku firing skills. He will demonstrate a variety of throwing, decorating and firing techniques.
summary: This four-day workshop with Randy Brodnax was scheduled for May 1-4, 2026 but has been cancelled.
bring: 10 small (8″x8″) grogged bisque pieces (Soldate-60 clay) or available for purchase
